name: Elfcare
description: Connect your account to ask Claude questions about your published health results, including your doctor summary, biomarkers, imaging results, body composition data, and trends over time. Access is read-only and requires your consent.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Elfcare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Elfcare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://patient.elf.care/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Elfcare MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elfcare provides these MCP tools: get_image, get_marker_history, get_marker_info, and get_results.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Elfcare?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Elfcare in consumer-health on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sweat & Tonic, Vitals Vault, It's Complicated — Therapist Directory, courtsapp, and CheckCells.
Elfcare requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Elfcare is developed by Elfcare AB. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
